title.zh: 选型边界：没有万能冠军

subtitle.zh: 从应用约束反推器件，而不是先选器件再解释
subtitle.en: Derive the device choice from application constraints instead of explaining an already chosen device

body.zh: 精密线性通常优先评估MIM；需要明显C-V变化或调谐时可评估MOS，但最终以PDK为准
body.en: Evaluate MIM first for precision linearity; evaluate MOS for substantial C–V variation or tuning, but ultimately follow the PDK

body.zh: 精密模拟/采样保持/ DAC
综合评估，不按单项冠军选
body.en: Assess all requirements; do not select a single-metric champion
ESR, area and available layers together

body.zh: C-V平坦度、匹配来源（工艺/版图/底板寄生）
body.en: C–V flatness and matching sources (process/layout/bottom-plate parasitics)

body.zh: 电压依赖性小，调谐能力有限
与电极层与介质相关，需核对可用层与密度
body.en: Depends on electrode layers and dielectric; check available layers and density

body.zh: 耐压与介质可靠性限制
介质损耗、ESR、走线与底板寄生
body.en: Dielectric loss, ESR, routing and bottom-plate parasitics

body.zh: 电极层可用性、层成本与布线资源占用
body.en: Electrode-layer availability, layer cost and routing-resource use

body.zh: C-V曲线形状、匹配来源（工艺/版图/衬底）
C-V范围、可调区与非线性代价
body.en: C–V range, tunable region and nonlinearity cost

body.zh: 与器件结构与偏压相关，需核对密度
body.en: Depends on device structure and bias; verify density

body.zh: 反型/弱反型/累积区限制与穿隧风险
通道/衬底损耗、ESR、走线与衬底寄生
body.en: Channel/substrate loss, ESR, routing and substrate parasitics

body.zh: 器件层与衬底连接成本、布线与Guard策略
body.en: Device-layer and substrate-connection cost, routing and guard strategy

body.zh: 带宽/中心频率偏移、Q下降
面积增加、热与可靠性风险
body.en: Increased area, thermal and reliability risks

body.zh: 验证闭环：模型 / PEX/ Corner / Monte Carlo / 硅后测试
body.en: Validation loop: models / PEX / corners / Monte Carlo / post-silicon tests

body.zh: 边界：最终结论必须服从具体PDK器件选项、设计规则、模型覆盖范围与可靠性手册。
body.en: Scope: final conclusions must follow the specific PDK device options, design rules, model coverage and reliability manual.
